purpose: Explicitly connects the accessory PQ research layer to canonical inventory identities without rewriting unresolved source conflicts.
matching_policy: A canonical_id is assigned only where the PQ accessory name can be matched to an existing canonical identity without inventing an alias.
null canonical_id means the PQ record still needs canonical identity reconciliation; the PQ research record remains authoritative for the research lead.
PQ association does not imply guaranteed acquisition unless the source layer explicitly establishes the reward condition.
Source conflicts are preserved rather than silently normalized.
